properties.name: Mariana Trench (Challenger Deep)
properties.desc: Deepest point on planet Earth, where the Pacific Plate subducts beneath the Mariana Plate.

properties.name: Tonga Trench (Horizon Deep)
properties.desc: Second deepest ocean trench on Earth, famous for extreme subduction velocity (up to 24 cm/year).

properties.name: Philippine Trench
properties.desc: Profound trench off eastern Philippines formed by subduction of the Philippine Sea Plate.

properties.name: Kuril-Kamchatka Trench
properties.desc: Intensely seismic trench fueling frequent magnitude 8+ megathrust earthquakes and Kamchatka volcanoes.

properties.name: Puerto Rico Trench (Milwaukee Deep)
properties.desc: Deepest point in the Atlantic Ocean, situated on a complex transform-subduction boundary.

properties.name: Java Trench (Sunda Trench)
properties.desc: Site of the devastating 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and mega-tsunami.

properties.name: South Sandwich Trench
properties.desc: Deepest point in the Southern Ocean, located along sub-Antarctic volcanic island arcs.
